editorial:
Imagine you are trying to climb the ladder in the mob, but your whole plan goes sideways because a friend dies from a bad batch of drugs. That is exactly where you find Jimmy Ricci. He is a low-level thug with big dreams, but he quickly turns into a man on a mission for revenge. The vibe is a wild mix of dark jokes and sudden violence, making you feel like you are riding a rollercoaster. You will love how the movie balances the scary parts of the crime world with moments that actually make you laugh out loud.

What really hits home is the acting and how fast the story moves. There are a few slow spots in the middle, but the crazy plot twists make up for it. If you love movies where the main character gets in over his head, you need to see this. You should definitely stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the detail in the fight scenes, or you can rent it on Apple TV for a movie night. If you are a collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, Jimmy finds out that his own boss was the one who supplied the bad drugs to kill his friend. This was a test to see if Jimmy was loyal or too emotional. Jimmy chooses revenge over loyalty and kills the boss in a messy shootout. He ends up taking over the crime family, but he realizes he is now completely alone. He wins the power, but loses every friend he ever had.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves crime stories with a sense of humor.
